summary: Production Alertmanager now delivers to Telegram (HelmCharts e9820f9 on phase/018-P2): critical loud, everything else silent, plain text, resolved notices, grouped per alertname/instance/node; NodeMemoryStallCounterWedged inhibits its node's two stall alerts (equal: [node]); bot token and chat id come as files from an ExternalSecret on eso/prd/prometheus/prd/telegram in the new manifests.yaml. New test pins routing/inhibition/secret wiring; amtool check-config and a local Alertmanager 0.34.1 with a fake Telegram API witnessed it; kc project test green.
